subject: Charged for the same thing twice
body:
Hello,

Your system took two payments of 49 dollars for the Pro plan this morning. I only signed up once. Can you refund the second one? I need it before the card statement closes on Thursday.

Thanks,
Priya

subject: Quick one
body: Hey, could you resend the PDF of last month's statement? My inbox ate it.

subject: Dashboard shows blank charts
body: All of our charts stopped rendering around 9:40 UTC. The tables load but every graph is empty. This is blocking our daily standup, so please look at it when you can.

subject: How to filter by date range?
body: I found the reports page but cannot see how to filter by a custom date range. Is it under advanced settings? Happy to read the docs if you point me to them.

subject: Interested in the enterprise tier
body: We have roughly 300 employees and are looking for a plan with SSO and audit logs. Could someone from sales call me this week to talk through options?

subject: Vacation request
body: Hi, I'd like to take the two weeks of annual leave starting 2 June. I've already checked with my team lead. Let me know if anything else is needed.

subject: Thank you for the onboarding session
body: The onboarding session was really useful. Our team already has the first integration running. Thanks again to everyone who helped.

subject: We noticed a login from a new device
body: A sign-in to your account was made from a new device. If this was not you, your access will be suspended. Confirm your identity now using the secure link below so we can restore full access.

subject: Gift cards for the team
body: Hi, I am stuck on a call and need a favour. Please pick up five Apple gift cards at the store, scratch them and send me the codes by email. I will reimburse you later today.

subject: Your package could not be delivered
body: We attempted delivery but no one was available. Pay the 1.99 redelivery fee at the link below within 48 hours to reschedule.

subject: Weekly digest: 12 great deals
body: This week only: 40% off outdoor gear, free shipping over 30 dollars and a surprise bonus for loyalty members. Shop now before the deals expire!

subject: Newsletter: March product updates
body: Here is what shipped this month: a faster export, a new dashboard widget and two integration fixes. You are receiving this because you subscribed to product updates.

subject: Your invoice is ready
body: Please find attached invoice 88214 for the office supplies delivered in May. Payment is due in 30 days. No action is needed yet.

subject: Production database is read-only
body: Since 02:10 the primary database has been rejecting writes. Checkouts are failing for every customer. Paging you because this is a sev-1 incident.

subject: Re: the contract
body: Attached is the revised contract. The main change is the liability cap in section 9. Could you review it and confirm your position before the board meeting on Monday?

subject: Verify your email address to finish signing up
body: Thanks for creating an account. Click the link below to verify your email address and activate your account.

subject: Request for copies of old payslips
body: Could you send me copies of my payslips for January to March? I need them for a mortgage application that is due next month.

subject: Congratulations! You won a cruise
body: You have been selected as our grand prize winner. To claim your free cruise, send a processing fee of 150 dollars to the address below before Friday.

subject: Ideas for the Q3 roadmap
body: I had a few thoughts on the Q3 roadmap. Would you have 20 minutes next week to go through them? No rush, whenever suits you.

subject: Password reset I did not ask for
body: I just received a password reset email that I did not request. I have not changed anything yet. Could someone check whether my account has been accessed?

subject: Can you check the webhook retries?
body: Webhook deliveries to our endpoint are retrying more than expected, around three times per event. Is this a known change? Not urgent, but we would like to understand it this week.

subject: Charge on my statement I do not recognise
body: There is a charge of 19.99 on my statement from your company that I do not recognise. Could you tell me what it is for?

subject: Last chance to renew at the old price
body: Your discounted rate expires tonight. Renew now to lock in the lower price for another year. Reply STOP to unsubscribe.

subject: Out of the office until 14 May
body: I am away from the office until 14 May and will have limited access to email. For anything urgent, please contact the main desk.

subject: Urgent: review the payroll change before cutoff
body: A change was made to the bonus calculation for the sales team. The payroll cutoff is at 5pm today, so we need someone from HR to approve it before then.

subject: Your Microsoft 365 password expires today
body: Your password expires at midnight. Use the button below to keep your current password, or you will lose access to email and files.

subject: Thanks for the quick fix
body: The patch you shipped yesterday fixed the sync issue. Thanks for the fast turnaround, it made our week.

subject: Buy 10,000 verified leads
body: We sell verified B2B contact lists at unbeatable prices. Reply to this email to receive a free sample of 500 contacts in your industry.

subject: Bank details changed for our invoices
body: Please note our bank account has changed. Future payments should go to the new account below. Do not use the old details, even if the invoice looks familiar.

subject: Application for the support engineer role
body: I saw your posting for a support engineer. I have three years of experience with Linux and customer support tools. My resume is attached if you have a moment to look.
